title: Carrier Global Corporation 8-K Filing — April 15, 2026 Annual Meeting Results
summary: Carrier Global Corporation (CARR) filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on April 15, 2026. All ten director nominees were elected, the advisory executive compensation vote passed, and PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP was ratified as independent auditor for 2026.
key_points: Record date was February 19, 2026; 835,433,325 shares outstanding
All ten director nominees elected with votes exceeding 693 million 'for' each
Advisory say-on-pay vote: 654,737,091 for (88.5%) vs 58,003,980 against (7.8%)
Signed by Patrick Goris, EVP Chief Financial & Strategy Officer on April 16, 2026
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance filing with no market-moving implications. The voting results indicate strong shareholder support for current leadership and compensation structure. The stock trades on NYSE under ticker CARR, but this filing contains no new financial guidance, material events, or strategic announcements.
